matrix.goal: Read the docs or inspect examples
required: Git if you clone the repository

matrix.goal: Create and build a native game
required: One package manager: pnpm, npm, or Yarn
Native linker/backend dependencies for the host
wasm-opt is optional for size optimization
The Perry target setup for the selected platform
Android SDK/NDK for the selected target

entries.title: Rust and Cargo
entries.notes: The Rust installation guide is also available at https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install.

entries.title: Node.js
entries.notes: Use the current Node.js LTS line for game-project package installation.

entries.title: Perry
entries.scope: Native, Apple, Android, and Web targets
entries.notes: Keep the perry executable on PATH so the BornEngine CLI can invoke it.

entries.title: Xcode
entries.notes: Xcode provides the Apple SDKs and simulators required by the selected target.

entries.title: Android Studio
entries.notes: Install the Android SDK and NDK components required by the selected Perry target.

entries.title: Windows C++ Build Tools
entries.notes: Use the Developer Command Prompt when checking cl.exe. Perry's setup may also require LLVM components.

entries.title: Linux backend packages
entries.install: sudo apt install pkg-config libx11-dev libxi-dev libasound2-dev
entries.notes: This is the minimum Debian/Ubuntu backend set documented by BornEngine; other distributions may use different package names.
